summary: Provides a comprehensive daily report of all fee collections, including admission heads and other income, with details like receipt number, student info, payment mode, and collected amounts per head.
navigation: Fees > Fee Reports > Combined Daily Collection
steps: View details such as receipt number, date, student admission number, student name, class, payment mode, and amount collected per fee head.
The report also shows which user processed the payment.
The report columns are editable, allowing users to customize displayed information (e.g., remove roll number).
business_rules: This report includes collections from admission heads and other income heads (miscellaneous) in addition to regular fee heads.
important_notes: This report is more comprehensive than the Daily Fee Report as it includes admission heads and other income.
questions: Where can I see all daily fee collections, including admission fees and other income?
